title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle: Compositional Generation with Energy-Based Diffusion Models and MCMC
role: Shows the summed score is not the noised product's score for t > 0 and fixes composition with per-step MCMC; the closest prior art for a corrector on top of CO3 and a caution on what the joint-minus-product gap contains.
reads: Each component's noise prediction eps(x,t) on the current noisy sample, converted to a score -eps/sigma_t; energy models also give a scalar f(x,t) = -||s(x,t)||^2 used in Metropolis accept steps; at every noise level.
trains: Score and energy diffusion models with L_t = E||eps - eps_theta(x_t,t)||^2 (energy: eps = -grad f): 2D MLPs, CLEVR 200k 64x64 images conditioned on one cube location (20k iterations), ImageNet 128 unconditional (1M iterations) plus a noisy classifier, a 64x64 text-to-image energy model on 400M images.
combines: Sum of component scores (log p(x) + sum_i (log p(x|y_i) - log p(x)) for CLEVR), then annealed MCMC (ULA, U-HMC, MALA, HMC) for N steps at each noise level after one reverse step, at an equal score-evaluation budget.
adding: Summing scores gives the product's score only at t = 0; for t > 0 it differs from the noised product's score, so reverse diffusion with the sum is wrong; same for tempering and CFG with lambda > 1; mixtures need energies; disjoint products fail.
noise_and_seed: not addressed; no seed variance or error bars; budgets held equal in score evaluations; ImageNet FID on 50,000 samples.
timesteps: not measured per timestep; sum and noised-product score agree only at t = 0; accuracy rises with MCMC steps per timestep (Fig. 5).
unseen: no: concepts are all seen; held-out combinations of 1 to 5 CLEVR cube locations from a model trained on one location per image; text-to-image binding and counting only qualitative.
headline: CLEVR 5-cube accuracy (% of samples with every cube placed, higher better) 72.7 for energy model with HMC vs 57.4 for score model with reverse diffusion (the Liu et al. 2022 baseline); own 64x64 U-Net.
suggests: (inferred) Part of the joint-minus-product gap at noisy steps exists even for an exact product, so the gap-predicts-term test should be read at low noise; repeating the reverse step at fixed noise with sqrt(2) noise is a cheap ULA corrector to try on CO3.
model: own pixel U-Nets (2D MLP, CLEVR 64x64, ImageNet 128x128), internal 64x64 energy text-to-image model; Imagen 64x64 base for tapestries

disagreements.claim: The PoE sum drops an interaction term that the joint prompt would have carried
disagreements.paper_says: Even for an exact product of the clean distributions, the noised product's score differs from the sum of noised scores at every t > 0, and the paper attributes composition failure to the sampler (not the model). Part of the joint-minus-sum gap at noisy steps is therefore not a property of the joint prompt.

Energy models with plain reverse diffusion score below score models (5 cubes 51.0 vs 57.4; ImageNet FID 33.58 vs 30.46), and the best ImageNet FID is the score model with U-HMC (26.89), not the energy model with HMC (30.52).
